complete_examples.text: In addition, the maximum number of elements in the tunnel segment is confirmed by numerical simulations.
The vertical displacement and acceleration of the tunnel segment at the bottom segment are the maxima because it directly bears the vehicle dynamic loads.
The tunnel segment is assembled by spatial iso-parametric elements, and the central angle with respect to each element is 6° according to previous research in (Xu and Zhai, 2021).

To validate the effectiveness of the proposed model, the experi-mental results of the floating slab vertical displacement and the 1/3 octave Frequency division vibration level (FDVL) of the tunnel segment acceleration are applied as the comparison indices.
